segments.ja383:1.3: Oroha dumasākhāya, mudhā bhariyā bhavāmi te.
segments.ja383:2.3: Migī pakkhī asaññuttā, aññaṃ pariyesa sāmikaṃ.
segments.ja383:3.3: Vinda maṃ ariyena vedena, sāvaya maṃ yadicchasi.
segments.ja383:4.3: Na tvaṃ ariyena vedena, mamaṃ bhattāramicchasi.
segments.ja383:5.1: Evampi caturā [cāturā (syā. ka.)] nārī, disvāna sadhanaṃ [pavaraṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] naraṃ;
segments.ja383:5.3: Nenti saṇhāhi vācāhi, biḷārī viya kukkuṭaṃ.
segments.ja383:6.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, na khippamanubujjhati;
segments.ja383:7.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ, khippameva nibodhati;

lines: Tattha komārikāti ahaṃ ettakaṃ kālaṃ aññaṃ purisaṃ na jānāmi, tava komārikā bhariyā bhavissāmīti vadati.
Ahampi hi ito pubbe purisasamphassaṃ na jānāmi, tvampi itthisamphassaṃ na jānāsi, iti pakatiyā brahmacārī brahmacāriniṃ maṃ niddosena lābhena labha.
Yadi maṃ icchasi, atha me vacanaṃ na saddahasi, dvādasayojanāya bārāṇasiyā bheriṃ carāpetvā “ayaṃ me dāsī”ti sāvaya, maṃ attano dāsaṃ katvā gaṇhāhīti vadati.
